verdicts.marker: Remcos agent: C2, keylogging, UAC bypass and process hollowing
execution_trace: CRT entry 0x4133d4 calls main 0x409146; main loads SETTINGS through 0x409c5e and splits decoded fields.

0x409c5e: first resource byte is key length; following bytes are RC4 key, remaining resource bytes ciphertext. Recovered 268-byte configuration with controller remcoss.onmypc.org:3765:pass and agent/path options.

Main eventually calls network loop 0x40cad4: resolve configured host, htons configured port, connect via 0x402324. 0x4023d2 receives framed data, 0x4024a0 decrypts/fragments it and dispatches callback 0x40d54b.
0x405332 installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL (13) callback 0x405317 and pumps messages; keyboard/clipboard recording paths are present.
0x40f2ef validates MZ/PE, creates suspended child, reads PEB image base, resolves NtUnmapViewOfSection, allocates/writes headers and sections, updates PEB/context, resumes thread.

0x4032e9 constructs mscfile shell command hijack and launches eventvwr; 0x40a4c8 launches cmd.exe and reg.exe to set EnableLUA=0. Browser-file deletion and Userinit writer paths support existing detections.
verdicts.verdict_reason: Configured remote-control agent combines surveillance, UAC bypass, hollowing, persistence and browser-store deletion. Those effects tip the judgment despite legitimate remote-administration uses of the product. No owner authorization or consent/deployment evidence was supplied.
limitations: No sample execution or network contact. Recovered configuration proves static settings, not successful C2 or enabled/successful execution of every supported command.
SETTINGS is configuration, not another executable stage. No archive members. Existing 10 hostile and 8 suspicious traits remain unchanged.

verdicts.identification: Credential hive and Active Directory backup script
verdicts.marker: Hive dumper: SAM/LSA and AD extraction; relocate traits
execution_trace: Straight-line batch commands export HKLM SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY into Windows Temp, then invoke ntdsutil.exe activate instance ntds ifm create full.

There is no encoded stage, downloader, network exfiltration, cleanup, persistence or privilege-elevation attempt. Successful hive export requires existing rights; NTDS backup requires an appropriate AD host and privileges.
verdicts.verdict_reason: Coordinated acquisition of local-account/LSA secret stores and the domain database into staging locations, together with the explicit post-exploitation/theft comment, tips this toward malicious post-exploitation. Legitimate backup or authorized assessment remains possible; neither authorization nor deployment context is provided.
limitations: NTDS IFM full backup is also a legitimate installation-media operation. Its standalone composite is now suspicious rather than hostile; SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY attack detections are preserved.
No archive members. Three retained hostile hive composites cover overlapping SAM and LSA targets; no extra traits were invented for absent network or persistence behavior.

verdicts.marker: Stealer scaffold: harvest routines and logon tasks; fix exfil claim
execution_trace: Top-level _E calls _d("KRv..."); base64.b64decode raises binascii.Error: Incorrect padding. Even with dependencies installed, normal module initialization stops before the main guard.
_d implements Base64 followed by XOR 0x5a and text decoding. These are decoder mechanics; the comments do not supply actual encoded values.
Defined _debug_check exits on a native debugger, on membership in a VM-guest process blacklist, and on disks under 50 GiB; sleeps PID modulo 30.

Defined _persist writes a Run value named WindowsUpdate and creates an ONLOGON task. Main passes sys.executable, so this schedules the Python interpreter without this script argument; durable re-execution of the stealer is not established.
Defined Chromium routine reads Local State, DPAPI-unprotects its key, queries Login Data, creates AES-GCM decryptor and discards decrypted results. It is never invoked.
Defined Firefox routine queries moz_cookies in cookies.sqlite and places.sqlite; it is never invoked and the latter normally lacks that table.
Defined Discord generator reads directory files, applies standard/MFA token regexes, validates candidates via Authorization to /users/@me and yields successful tokens. It is never invoked.
_wifi only lists WLAN profiles; it does not request passwords, and its returned stdout is discarded.

_exfil constructs a ZIP in BytesIO and uploads to a locally loaded Base64/XOR-decoded URL. Main passes an empty dictionary: no browser, token or Wi-Fi data is attached. The URL file is absent from the supplied artifact.
verdicts.verdict_reason: Credential-harvesting routines, analysis-evasion gates and concealed system-named autorun installation form an offensive stealer design. The malformed table and disconnected collection paths make it an incomplete/inert scaffold; they prevent claims of successful theft, but do not establish a legitimate purpose. No training/test provenance or owner authorization was supplied.
limitations: Original hostile browser-file-exfil rule falsely equated co-occurrence with data flow. Its supported evidence is retained as a suspicious Chromium/DPAPI/upload-context finding; a separate precise query-result-to-multipart rule retains directly provable transfer coverage.
Mutable ZIP-buffer contents and interprocedural collector-to-uploader flows are not inferred. The engine still reports flow-graph-limited, flow-field-unavailable and flow-query-incomplete.
The persistence detection describes task registration by code with browser-password decryption capability; it does not assert that the installed interpreter task re-runs this script.

changes: Relocate registry-hive observations to objectives/credential-access/registry; relocate NTDS IFM observations to objectives/credential-access/files/password-database. Preserve matchers/scopes and explicit ancestor consumer membership.
Reduce standalone NTDS IFM composite to suspicious: full installation-media backup alone does not establish unauthorized credential theft.

Replace unproven browser-upload hostility with retained suspicious co-occurrence plus argument-provenance detection for actual Chromium password-query results reaching requests/httpx multipart upload.

Add file-to-Discord-token regex harvesting and validation; browser-decryptor logon-task registration; process-membership exit gate and VM blacklist conjunction; XOR-to-text decoding and disk-usage query.
Extend existing Python debugger-abort matcher to native Windows debugger checks and rename it accurately; update exact consumers, retaining trace-query coverage.

Narrow Open VM Tools identity from guest-tool names to its self-version banner template; retain guest-tool references in neutral hypervisor/name observations. This removes erroneous identity suppression of the Python VM check.

registry_consumers: Exact ntdsutil consumer in Impacket preserved.
Broad dump selector in web-served credential staging gains only the three moved NTDS IDs.
Config secret-sweep hive consumer uses a named exact-membership group of the nine original hive IDs, rather than all registry rules.
Fallout regression expectations updated to moved IDs. Positive hive dumping and recorded-event near miss tested.
shared_rule_review.browser_upload_consumers: No exact consumers of removed python-dpapi-browser-secret-file-upload-exfil. Reviewed browser-import-candidate and keychain-source fixtures outside this batch; none establishes a real multipart browser-to-send flow. New positive transfer and disconnected-upload controls verify precise replacement while retaining Chromium decryption.
shared_rule_review.vm_identity_consumers: Audited guest-artifact, guest-name cluster, CPUID references, socket-pilot, VMware log path, generic backdoor exclusion, ESXi TLS exception and Linux persistence suppressor. Genuine suite source retains identity; names alone do not suppress attack indicators.
shared_rule_review.anti_debug_consumers: Renamed direct/check composites, aliased-check exclusion and Unix Python wrapper consumer; retained original trace-abort matcher semantics, tested with trace-exit.py.

verification.archive_members: None: inputs are one PE and two plain scripts; PE resource decodes to configuration only.
